notes.title: THE WORLD MAILBOX UPDATE
notes.content:
Hello all ːdentonː



It's been a little while hasn't it ? I’ve been working on life and other projects, but this game still has my heart, so alongside everything else, I’ve been adding in new things, making this update.


New Journal System
Players can now create as many journal pages as they please.

Each page can either use a pre-defined prompt (written by Naveen ofc), or choose to title them yourself.

Each page also lets you pick a mood to reflect how you’re feeling that day.


Design Updates
Sol got a whole new look! the old one was a bit too thin and didn’t scale well. The new look is softer, warmer, and fits her mother-like persona alot better.

Neptune now has cool waterfall-like visual effects flowing through its body.

Jupiter now has her tail! idk why she never had one to begin with.


New Character Animations
Gave all the characters some bone-based animations. Everyone feels more alive and expressive now.


Inventory/Bag
The inventory is now _always visible_ on the HUD.

Added a juicy pop-in/out effect when you open/close the bag. Super satisfying.


Colour Customisation System
Added a system allowing you to change the colours of your collected items.

This system also works with the letters in the mailbox system (more on that later).


Redesigned the Report Card
New look + new approach to stat tracking. 


Polished some minigames
Aphrodite’s Habit Minigame

New sound effects, animations, and icons.

Habits now have unique icons, helping to visually sort what’s “good” or “bad” in a more interactive way.



Neptune’s Self-Love Minigame

Tried giving it more visual feedback;

Input box flashes correct/incorrect colours.

Added a progress indicator - Neptune starts out as a chaotic splash, but slowly takes shape as you make positive progress with your thoughts (symbolism).



Atlas’ Meditation Minigame

Also tried giving it more visual feedback;

Now there’s a calming Atlas illustration, filling up as you meditate.

Also added an illustrated breathing guide, showing you how to inhale through the nose, and exhale through the mouth. It's pretty cute.


Spotlight System
Whenever you interact with something (a character, your inventory, the mailbox), the background now darkens to keep focus on what matters.


Settings Menu
Reworked the look and layout of settings, tidying everything up.


Information Screen
Slightly improved the look of it too, with a cleaner layout and animated text.


Sol's Mood System
Before venting, Sol now gently asks how you’re feeling.

You’ll see a bunch of illustrated emotions to choose from, a low-pressure way to express/identify your current emotional status.



now, last but not least...
THE NEW WORLD MAILBOX SYSTEM !!!
my favourite things I’ve added.

a system to ask questions to the strangers of our world, and to read their thoughts.



Envelopes = Questions, Letters = Answers.

You (the player) can send letters (that you write) to envelopes (that I write). It’s a lil wholesome community-driven system for sharing and connecting with one another.

I've made the letters customisable using different shapes, colours, and Unity's TextMeshPro tool. Boldness, text colour, size, alignment, opacity etc, make your message truly unique, like you.

Envelopes come with their own unique themes; such as heart-shaped letters for love-related topics, or “note” style letters for "messages to strangers".





Thank you all for your continued support with my game development journey, i hope you all enjoy what this update has to offer :).



See you soon in future updates and or in the next project,

Malachi

notes.title: ILM,ILMN COMES TO MOBILE
notes.content:
Hello, It's been a while!

I've been working on improving this game for a little while, making changes where I can here and there during any free time that I had. Anyway, let's not ramble on too long.

The Mobile Game!
"i love me, i love me not" is now fully playable on both your Android and iOS mobile devices! 

Developing for mobile devices came with many many design and gameplay issues, it was quite a learning curve that I'm still learning to navigate. Anyway, with the mobile device, I was also able to add some new functionality to the game I've never been able to explore before, such as achievements, notifications, and vibrations!


The Update
This update brings many changes to the game, so let's go through them:

PLAYER

slightly increased the player's eyes + animated them.
added fading footsteps, creating a trail behind the player wherever they walk. 
added different sound effects when walking on the path vs walking on the grass.
players now resume/spawn in the game wherever they left off (position)


CHARACTERS

new character, Jorm! Jorm is used to introduce a new player to the game and help guide them around the field. 
added shadows to each character, making them pop a little more!
added a blinking animation to each character, except Atlas, obviously.
characters and notes now highlight (white outline) when they're intractable.


UI

 new dialogue design, it's now soft n cloudy and auto-scales with text.
new input box redesign too, same as dialogue style.
settings menu redesign, added some more settings, and tabs of information.
added dark mode setting! makes dialogue and items use dark colours instead of light.
improved notes, and todolist slide-out animations
added a new info screen, explaining how to play a task/minigame.
new font style for interaction prompts, and event logs.
improved the reward petal scene a little.


ENVIRONMENT

redesigned Naveen's area. added ambient SFX, fish swimming, and lilypads.
added flowing/falling leaves particle FX.
added 2 new foliage types to the grass.
added some 3D sound effects.



TASKS/MINIGAMES

improved Aphrodite's minigame. more variation of habits, better animation when adding/breaking habits, and better sound effects.
improved Neptune's minigame. more variation of thoughts, more possible responses, animated phrase text, and better sound effects,
improved Jupiter's minigame. added a walkthrough text to help guide the player to create origami in real life, making the player now click and drag a point from one position to the next.
improved Naveen's journal. adding more prompts.
improved Atlas' minigame. mostly behind-the-scenes improvements for optiomisation.
made the "show gratitude" task actually give away the origami item. So, the player can now return to Jupiter and make more and more, gifting origami to everyone in the field!


EXTRA

changed some characters' dialogue, polishing the message they're trying to teach.
reworked the save system, allowing it to work with the cloud saves, and hopefully old save files too.
fixed a lot of typos.
fixed a lot of bugs.


as always, please share any bugs, thoughts and ideas you may have with me. the best place to reach me is on my discord server. thank you all for playing :)

OTHER

 fixed some bugs (OOB save corruption, neptune minigame completion acknowledgenent, jupiter minigame restart, aphrodite minigame restart)


if you run into any new (or old) bugs, PLEASE let me know, the best place to contact me is in our discord server. hope you all enjoy the update :)

notes.title: improvements and plans !
notes.content:
sorry for the lack of updates recently, I've been quite occupied with a few other projects, my placement year, and general life (i'm also v lazy at times, 2023 is the year i finally change that ːdentonː)

i've worked on very minor changes to help improve the general gameplay experience, some of these changes have been based on feedback I've received from reviews, so thank you to those helping me build a better game for me and everyone else!

small changes : 

 made the meditation task more explanatory (breathe in through the mouth and out through the nose).
 made the heartbreak task more explanatory too. The bad habits are darker, making what is "good" and what is "bad" a lot clearer.
 added out of bounds, you can no longer walk into the boundless and empty blue Unity void.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43055224/d2f5ead35e1d6af725c88f71c9c1611eba5c6dc9.png

 fixed a bug with the meditation task not restarting properly.
 fixed a bug with music volume (might just generally lower the volume altogether in a future update?).


future plans : 
also, from feedback and reviews, a lot of you have shared some great ideas with me! here are a couple I've taken into consideration and want to work on for future updates.


 cloud saves - steam cloud saves are coming! i'm still quite new to game dev so this is something i haven't experimented with before, but i do understand how i'd go about implementing this. please remain patient with me on this :)

 journal - people seem to really like the journal! they want more out of it so i'm thinking of some end-game additions to add to the journal, like being able to freely create extra pages of more prompts, or even blank pages just to vent out on. this would ultimately allow the player to build up their own little virtual journal with thoughts and ideas, which i think is beautiful

 self-love task - i want to allow the user to give more than one response to the self-love task, this would make it a little more unique to each player rather than having one set "answer" for each phrase.

I also think it'd be cool to allow the user to think up of personal self-love phrases and affirmations to say to themself rather than countering the ones given. Not sure how i'd implement this yet, possibly an alternate end-game task?

 more music ! - i'd like each character to have their own little theme-tune when completing their task. It'd build so much character.

 customisation - allow the user to customize their sunflower, like the colour of each petal? idk, i want some sort of freedom for the player to express themself a little more.

 notes - i'd love for the player to be able to write and receive notes from other real players (like the game "Kind Words"). you'll be able to talk to Sol and request some notes to start that initial scavenger hunt again, this time the notes will be written from players across the world, sharing their positive thoughts, ideas and advice with each other. these notes will be added to the bag just like the original notes you'd collect.
